notes.title: Unravel the Mystery:A Death in the Red Light is Out NOW!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44979378/36aaacb0a40de29d150b10c76a9cc82c2d958a5d.png[/img]

[h3]🌟 Thank You to Our Incredible Community! 🌟[/h3]
We couldn’t have made it here without you. After months of hard work and your constant support, we're thrilled to announce that [b]A Death in the Red Light[/b] is finally [b]LIVE on Steam[/b]! We’re beyond excited for you to dive into this unique detective adventure set in 1980s Amsterdam’s red light district. Your support has been our guiding light, and we can’t wait to hear what you think.

🎥 Watch the Launch Trailer:
Check out our newest trailer and glimpse the thrilling journey that awaits.
[previewyoutube=Fs7HSnTFTmQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]🕵️ Top Features to Look Forward To:[/h2]

[b]True Crime Mystery:[/b] Solve a gripping mystery based on real events in Amsterdam’s shadowy underworld.

[b]Intricate Puzzles: [/b]Use your wits and detective tools to crack the case.

[b]Atmospheric Setting:[/b] Immerse yourself in 1980s Amsterdam, with stunning visuals and period-accurate details.

[h2]💪How You Can Support Us 💪[/h2]
As a small indie team, we rely on your support in many ways. Here’s how you can help:

If you enjoy the game, please consider[b] leaving an honest review on Steam![/b] Reviews have a massive impact on indie games and we'd love to hear your thoughts and experiences.

[b]Spread the word![/b] Share A Death in the Red Light with friends, family, and social media followers.

[b]Every share helps[/b] someone discover their next favorite game!

[b]Join our awesome community on [url=https://www.instagram.com/mysterycitygames/]Instagram[/url] [/b] and follow us for updates, discussions, and more exciting content!


[h3]🔗 Download the game now! [/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2866640/A_Death_in_the_Red_Light/

notes.title: Wishlist Now! Launching Our New Detective Game Based on a True Crime Story
notes.content:
Get ready to immerse yourself in the underworld of [b]1980s Amsterdam [/b]with our thrilling new detective game, inspired by a [b]real crime story[/b]. Step into the shoes of a sharp investigator and navigate the shadows of the city's notorious[b] red light district[/b]. Uncover hidden secrets, crack cryptic puzzles, and chase down elusive clues—all from the comfort of your home. 🕵️‍♂️

[h3]🎮 Launch Date: [b]September 23, 2024[/b][/h3]

📽️ Watch the Trailer: 
[previewyoutube=wTLhTYpcPis;full][/previewyoutube]

Examine intricate crime scenes with interactive elements and hidden details.
Immerse yourself in an authentic 1980s Amsterdam setting with true-to-life locations and events.
Solve complex detective cases with interactive, puzzle-based gameplay.
